title: Read your drop's results
summary: See what your drop brought in, where people came from, and what to change next time.

steps.title: Open your drop
steps.body: Go to Drops and tap the drop. The numbers update live while it runs.

steps.title: The headline numbers
steps.body: "This drop brought in" adds up the amounts staff logged when redeeming. Until you log one, you see how many Tikkas were redeemed instead. You also see claims, Tikkas left and time left.

steps.title: Where people drop off
steps.body: "Where people drop off" follows people step by step: opened the link, tore open the wrapper, tapped Claim, continued to WhatsApp, claimed, redeemed, and followed up. A big drop between two steps tells you what to fix, like making your offer clearer.

steps.title: Where people came from
steps.body: "By source" shows which link brought the most claims: WhatsApp status, Instagram, QR code, your website, ads and the marketplace. Share more where it works.

steps.title: Change a running drop
steps.body: You can extend the end date, add more Tikkas, or end the drop early. You can't change the rewards once it's published.

tips: When a drop ends, tap "Run it again" on Drops to start the next one with the same setup.
